name: mergado-param-enrichment
description: Fills in missing product parameters (colour, size, material, composition, capacity) in a Mergado project by extracting them from text the project already has — the product name first, then structured text such as a specification, the description last. Builds one regex or value dictionary per parameter instead of calling AI per product, refuses to fill conditional or multi-component values blindly, and also detects parameters that are filled but truncated on the way to the output.
